title: Senior Data Center Supply Chain Manager (IC3)
description:
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) is seeking an experienced individual contributor to lead strategic supply chain initiatives for the critical infrastructure required to build and operate OCI’s rapidly expanding global data center footprint.


Reporting to the VP of Data Center Supply Chain, this role will own key sourcing, planning, procurement, and supplier\-management workstreams for mechanical, electrical, and infrastructure equipment supporting next\-generation cloud data centers. The successful candidate will work across cooling, power, and prefabricated infrastructure categories, helping secure supply for long\-lead equipment essential to hyperscale deployments.


This role will partner closely with Data Center Engineering, Construction, Capacity Planning, Finance, Global Procurement, Manufacturing Operations, Logistics, and Cloud Infrastructure Operations to enable predictable, scalable delivery of OCI infrastructure.


  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and execute category and sourcing strategies for critical data center infrastructure equipment.
* Lead supplier engagements, RFx processes, commercial negotiations, and contract\-development activities for assigned categories.
* Partner with Capacity Planning, Engineering, and Construction teams to translate infrastructure roadmaps into demand plans and procurement strategies.
* Develop and maintain forecasts for long\-lead mechanical and electrical equipment, identifying supply constraints and mitigation actions early.
* Manage strategic supplier relationships, including performance across capacity, quality, delivery, cost, and responsiveness.
* Support negotiations for pricing, capacity reservations, lead times, warranties, service agreements, and long\-term supply commitments.
* Identify opportunities to diversify supply sources, improve supply continuity, and reduce operational, geopolitical, and supplier\-concentration risk.

Technical Infrastructure Program Manager (TIPM)
description: Join the Future of Compute as a Technical Project Manager! Are you Ready to Build the Future of AI Infrastructure? If you're energized by massive scale, deep technical complexity, and the opportunity to shape the next era of compute, this is your moment. Join a team where groundbreaking work meets competitive compensation, meaningful impact, and a chance to accelerate your career at the forefront of AI innovation. We want to meet you. Why IREN? IREN is a vertically integrated AI Cloud provider, delivering large-scale data centers and GPU clusters for AI training and inference. IREN's platform is underpinned by its expansive portfolio of grid-connected land and power in renewable-rich regions across North America, Europe and APAC. With 100% renewable energy, we build, own and operate our data centers and take pride in being at the forefront of sustainable solutions for the ever-evolving applications of high-performance compute. We believe that human progress is invaluable, but it should be done in the right way – responsibly, sustainably and having a positive impact on the communities we operate in. This position is based in Canada – Multiple Sites, with a hybrid work arrangement. Occasional travel is required across Canadian and US operations. Basic Qualifications: · Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Construction Management, or related discipline, or equivalent experience. · 3+ years of Technical Project Management experience. · Experience supporting delivery of technical infrastructure projects. · Experience coordinating cross-functional engineering and operational teams. · Experience supporting integrated project schedules. · Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Preferred Qualifications: · Experience supporting AI infrastructure or hyperscale data centre environments. · Experience with GPU compute platforms and HPC infrastructure. · Experience delivering technical deployment or operational remediation project
